format: DanceFlow Studio/Custom competition entries (all disciplines); not a governing-body profile
requirement: A competition manager scratches an entry only before it dances and only while none of its heats is locked, certified or on the floor, with a recorded reason, through the audited lifecycle RPC. A scratch is distinct from a no-show, an organizer exclusion and a disqualification, changes no money, and is not reversed by this workflow.
enforcement_point: Database: change_competition_entry_lifecycle refuses non-managers and locked or certified heats. Application only: the danced / on-the-floor refusal, the source-status restriction, the required reason and the sequential replay no-op.

tests.name: refuses locked / certified heats, recorded placements and started or finished heats without calling the RPC
keeps Scratched, Withdrawn and a stored disqualified status distinct, never as an organizer exclusion (OD-20)
refuses an event outside the signed-in studio

interpretation_notes: Unverified: tests model the database, and no SQL was executed for this change. Application-only checks are not a database boundary (they are time-of-check / time-of-use on the live RPC; the draft, unapplied S6 20270301140000 moves them into the database; see docs/competition/sc1-live-line-port.md). No governing-body rule book was consulted for this port and none is claimed. Governing-body scratch, missed-call and disqualification procedures (including those recorded under OD-20 for UCWDC and NDCA) are NOT IMPLEMENTED and belong to future profiles; organizer_staff may scratch because the existing manager authority is unchanged.
